_comment: Four unattended posts per day since 13 Sep 2026, mapped per cron slot in .github/workflows/post.yml: 09:07 image card (no YouTube), 12:37 short sales reel, 16:37 short motion sales reel, 19:37 the weekday format below at standard length. No Veo generation on the scheduled path.

reel._why: Each reel starts with an 8-second Veo hook, followed by roughly 17 to 22 seconds of narrated product cards. Keep the complete reel near 25 to 30 seconds for completion rate.

film._why: Two footage beats (about 8s and 7s) plus two cards. Completion rate is what earns reach.

demo._why: Headline about 3s, the question typing about 4s, the answer arriving and holding about 8s, then the price card about 5s. Completion rate is what earns reach, so the narration stays short.

sales.notes: Voice and reading time determine duration. Never cut narration or the CTA.
